reviews.title: Amazon took care of it quick.
reviews.comment: Amazon went above in beyond in assisting me with this. I have 4 computers I am delivering soon and one of the CPU's was bad. Amazon took care of it quickly and Amazon got me a replacement the next day which was amazing and a great help to me as I need them ready in 2 days and that helped me to take care of it and meet my timeframe. Thank you Amazon! CPU worked great and its a great CPU also.
reviews.author: Anonymous

reviews.title: Excellent value for the performance you get.
reviews.comment: Product works perfectly. Installed it with good thermal paste and a 240 mm AIO. Temps have hit 60C under load but no higher than that. Scored where it should running cinebench r 23 and 2024. Excellent price to performance ratio for more than just gaming.
reviews.author: Jeremy Dale

reviews.title: perfect for Proxmox server
reviews.comment: I bought this as part of a new Proxmox build to replace a much older system.  This processor meets all my needs (small home lab environment) and priced right.  No complaints really.
reviews.author: K. Thomas

reviews.title: Perfect for Unraid
reviews.comment: Perfect processor for an Unraid server. Getting pretty low Tdp with C States enabled. Also, it has good transcoding performance with its iGPU.
reviews.author: Juan C. Jaramillo M

reviews.title: CPU is great, stock cooler junk
reviews.comment: CPU itself is awesome. It plays any high intensive modern games at 4K without any issues. Only one downside is included stock cooler. If you plan to game at 4K, stock cooler is garbage. I had to change it to other higher end air cooler. Now everything works under low temps and loads while gaming.
reviews.author: George
